units.source_text: "我想摆脱自己周围的一切事物，摆脱自己周围的事物所喷发出来的有气无力的气味……

en.t: I want to break free from everything around me, from the feeble smell given off by the things that surround me...

units.source_text: 我终于懂得老师也是无力的，是非常无力的啊！"

en.t: At last I understood that the teacher too was powerless, terribly powerless!"
